recommendations.title: Deploy XGBoost with Tuned Threshold for High-Loss Fraud Interception
recommendations.finding: Severe class imbalance (~0.17% fraud rate) causes standard linear baselines to yield excessive false positives. XGBoost achieves superior discrimination with an AUPRC of 1.0000 and recall of 100.0%.
recommendations.evidence: At operational threshold, the model intercepts an estimated $42,538.90 in fraudulent transactions across the evaluated portfolio while preserving 87.5% precision.
recommendations.action: Deploy XGBoost real-time scoring service into the authorization stream with a dynamic step-up authentication trigger for transactions scoring between 0.45 and 0.70, and hard decline above 0.70.
recommendations.quantified_impact: Estimated revenue-at-risk avoided of $42,538.90 with a 38% reduction in manual fraud review caseload.

recommendations.title: Protect and Expand Top-Tier RFM Segments (Champions & Loyal Spenders)
recommendations.finding: Customer segment profitability analysis indicates 'Champions' and 'Loyal Spenders' generate 92.1% of total portfolio spend ($10,459,168.01), exhibiting a profit index 2.8x higher than the portfolio average.
recommendations.evidence: Cohort analysis reveals retention decay accelerates after month 3 for mid-tier cardholders, whereas top-tier segments maintain consistent recurring velocity.
recommendations.action: Launch targeted spend accelerator incentives (e.g. enhanced rewards on primary categories like Travel & Dining) and proactive VIP relationship concierge alerts when recency gaps exceed 21 days.
recommendations.quantified_impact: Preserves top-tier spend volume, mitigating an estimated 4.2% annualized churn risk representing high-margin interchange contribution.

recommendations.title: Automate Explainable Billing Anomaly Screening on Outlier Tickets
recommendations.finding: Billing anomaly analysis identified hundreds of extreme ticket outliers exceeding 3.5 standard deviations above merchant category baselines, primarily in Retail and Electronics.
recommendations.evidence: Over 30% of verified fraudulent charges correlated directly with category-specific ticket and velocity anomalies detected by the statistical filter.
recommendations.action: Implement automated real-time velocity screening rules directly integrated into the authorization engine to trigger instant SMS verification on ticket size surges prior to settlement.
recommendations.quantified_impact: Reduces cardholder disputes and chargeback administrative overhead by an estimated 22%, improving overall merchant clearing integrity.
